item.title: AI on WhatsApp and Telegram: Complete Guide to Chatting with ChatGPT, Perplexity, Meta AI, and More
item.description:
AI on WhatsApp and Telegram: Complete Guide to Chatting with ChatGPT, Perplexity, Meta AI, and More

Artificial Intelligence is no longer limited to websites and mobile apps. Many AI assistants can now be accessed directly from popular messaging platforms like WhatsApp and Telegram, allowing users to ask questions, generate content, translate languages, summarize documents, write code, and even create images without installing dedicated applications.

This guide provides an overview of the AI assistants currently available on WhatsApp and Telegram, how to access them, what features they offer, and what limitations to expect.

item.title: The Prompt Engineering Blueprint: How to Build Production-Grade AI Agents with Constrained Logic
item.description:
If you have ever asked a Large Language Model (LLM) to perform complex analysis, you have likely run into the “chatty AI” problem. When left unconstrained, AI models default to generic intros, vague advice, inconsistent formatting, and hallucinated calculations.

To transform an LLM from a standard chatbot into a production-grade analytical tool, you must move away from conversational prompts and adopt Constrained Execution Frameworks.

Below is a detailed breakdown of how advanced prompt architectures—like the Mutual Fund Evaluator and Stock Fundamental Analyser—work, why they perform so well, and how you can adapt them for your own domain.
